hypothesis: Scope separation collapses the commentary-driven CER inflation: layered primary CER improves on every two-layer page relative to the 0.443086 full-page champion, healthy one-layer pages do not regress, the assembled consensus pipeline beats the champion macro CER, and scope-correct consensus precision reaches 0.99 on healthy pages.
decision: Adopt the layered read as the new best single-pass AncientDoc identity (macro 0.385179 versus champion 0.443086; the Chu Ci page collapsed from 2.136564 to 0.475771 with zero adjudication) and keep the deterministic scope layer. Reject column-grain dispute adjudication: isolated crop re-reads lose page context and regressed most healthy pages at $3.08 for negative aggregate value, the same context-loss failure that rejected column-mode replacement. The two-layer improvement gate failed 6 of 10 not because the scope layer is wrong but because AncientDoc gold scope is inconsistent across books: some volumes' gold includes the small-character text others exclude, so no single scope can match all books, and per-book best-scope selection reaches 0.355552 macro. Consensus precision rose to 0.968266 micro on healthy pages (0.974178 macro, four pages at 1.000000) but remains short of the 0.99 target; the residue is same-error agreement on degraded handwriting and junk-box columns, not generation failures.

layered_results.empty_primary_note: Both are one-layer pages whose reader misrouted all text into the commentary field, the table because its cells are uniformly small, the detector-failure spread because its count anchors were wrong. The scorer applies a declared deterministic repair: one-layer page with empty primary uses the commentary field text.

dispute_results.pairing: 125 agreed, 293 disputed of 446 primary-column pairings; column-grain exact agreement is inherently coarse because both channels must read an entire column identically
dispute_results.adjudicated_of_disputes: 178 of 293; the dispute budget stop fired at $3.079709 against the declared $3.00, so 115 disputes on the last 14 alphabetical cases fell back to channel A text as declared
dispute_results.finding: Crop-isolated adjudication regressed most fully-adjudicated healthy pages (0.078 to 0.156, 0.078 to 0.132, 0.036 to 0.050) while pages that received zero adjudication and kept layered lines improved. Page context is load-bearing for the reader; the adjudicator must see disagreement evidence in page context, not isolated crops.

final_pipeline_results.note: The aggregate gain over the champion comes from the layered scope wins, not from dispute adjudication.

consensus_results.grain: column-exact agreement between layered primary lines and primary-layer column channel
consensus_results.trajectory: 0.947535 scope-blind character-grain, then 0.968266 scope-aware column-grain; the remaining errors are both-channels-same-error on degraded handwriting (0.76 on the one degraded page) and junk-box margin columns the gold excludes (0.49 on the fold-label page)
consensus_results.coverage_tradeoff: Column-grain agreement covers only 37.7 percent of healthy gold versus 89 percent for character-grain; the production consensus should therefore be character-grain within column alignment, not column-exact.

gate_status.layered_completion: fail: 2 empty primary fields, deterministically repaired and recorded
gate_status.two_layer_improvement: fail: 6 of 10, caused by per-book gold scope inconsistency, not scope-layer error
gate_status.dispute_truncation: pass: 1 failed and 1 truncated of 178, 1.1 percent
gate_status.pipeline_gate: pass numerically: 0.409656 below 0.443086, attributable to scope not disputes

evidence.scorer: rapidfuzz 3.14.3 Levenshtein distance, normalized similarity, and opcodes, installed for scoring and removed afterward

limitations: Development evidence on 28 cases; no qualification suite, no promotion.
Half the cases received no dispute adjudication because the sub-budget stop fired; their final texts are layered lines plus channel-A fallbacks.
Layer misrouting on uniformly-small-character pages shows count anchors alone do not bind the reader's layer assignment.
Gold scope inconsistency is now a measured property of AncientDoc development gold, and per-book scope handling or versioned gold correction is required before any qualification use.
next_permitted_action: Three concrete follow-ups: score both layered fields per book and pick scope per volume deterministically from gold metadata rather than per page; move consensus to character grain within the existing column alignment to recover coverage at the measured precision; and redesign the disagreement pass to show the full page with the disputed column highlighted instead of an isolated crop. Any gold change follows the gold-correction protocol with a new version.
